newsitem.title: USA: Two Bridger 550 MW coal-fired units still off line.
newsitem.headline: Two Bridger 550 MW coal-fired units still off line.

text.p: Two of the four 550 megawatt (MW) units at the Jim Bridger coal-fired power plant in Wyoming were expected to restart by midday on Wednesday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday.

Bridger unit 4, which has been down for planned maintenance since late last month, failed to resume operations as planned on Monday night, and operators were expected to try again sometime before midnight Tuesday.
Unit 1 was taken off-line for unplanned repairs on Monday and was expected to restart around midday on Wednesday, the sources said.
The Bridger plant is owned by PacifiCorp and Idaho Power Co..
